predictions.rationale: Primary class representing the Deployment Diagram itself in the core application; central to creation, behavior and visualization of deployment diagrams.
Defines the graph model for deployment diagrams (nodes, edges, artifacts), which is essential for representing runtime architecture elements.
Responsible for drawing/rendering deployment diagram figures (nodes, artifacts, connections) in the UI.
Initializes the deployment diagram subsystem; registers diagram type, actions, and factories at application start-up.
Implements the properties panel shown when a deployment diagram is selected; directly supports editing of deployment diagram settings.
Factory that creates property panels for deployment diagrams; ties UI configuration to the feature.
User action class that lets users create/open a new deployment diagram from menus or toolbar, directly enabling the feature.
Alternative/next-generation implementation of the Deployment Diagram within the ‘deployment2’ module; mirrors primary diagram functionality.
Graph model for the deployment2 variant, defining nodes/edges and their relationships for deployment diagrams.
Factory responsible for creating deployment2 diagram instances; supports instantiation and integration of the diagram type.
